title: Amazing day trip
text:

author: Nancy_N

title: Views from each town were...
text: Views from each town were fabulous - and it was great to see each place with our private tour guide.
author: Chris_D

title: Ronda & White Villages
text: Our guide was from Ronda so his knowledge of the area was incredible.  We loved touring the White Villages and thoroughly loved our day in Ronda.  We were lucky to be in Ronda for their celebration of 450 years.  The King of Spain was there for the celebration!  It was an exciting tour!
author: Suzanne_H

title: Evasion
text:
Very nice heritage discovery, picturesque villages, an oil factory visit, lunch in a restaurant advisor by our guide
 who, by the way, has captured our attention!
Thank you for this beautiful day away from the noise of the city a real happiness.
But above all thanks to our guide Nieves for his knowledge, his humor, and his shared passion.
author: Z1873JXsabinee

title: A great day tour to Ronda and the two White villages of Zahara and Grazalema
text:
An excellent tour organised by the tour operator Naturanda Turismo Ambiental in Seville. Arrangements for the tour were well organised including the option (extra charge €15 well worth it) of a hotel pickup from Triana which went smoothly. The guide Reyes from Naturanda was excellent, she was efficient and caring in looking after all people on the tour and her knowledge of the locations visited was superb.
The tour itself is impressive and once the coach climbed into the mountains near the white village of Zahara the views were incredible. The visit to this village involved an interesting tour
author: RogerB53

title: We had a fabulous time and a great...
text:
We had a fabulous time and a great driver guide with Franz. He collected us and brought us home to our door. We were taken to Ronda and Grazalema and saw the sights there. Franz was very knowledgable about the area and answered all our questions.
Ronda is a fantastic place to visit and walk around. We visited the oldest bull fighting ring in Spain too.
We had a very full day touring and it was well worth it. Thank you Franz.
author: Graeme S

title: Our guide was knowledgable, relaxed...
text: Our guide was knowledgable, relaxed, friendly, and showed us the sights. He made the effort to take us to a local's restaurant and suggested food to try. The sights in Ronda and the White Villages are well worth the day trip!
author: KatherineJ_C
